query: INSERT INTO app.session_revocation (id, account_id, idp_session_id, reason_code, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_session_revocation_idp_session_id DO UPDATE SET expires_at = GREATEST(app.session_revocation.expires_at, EXCLUDED.expires_at) RETURNING expires_at
